notes: Scope: the ORIGINAL Numark NS7 (2009). Per the reference manual v1.1 pp.5-8 it has no built-in FX section (FX came with the separate NS7FX add-on), so there are no fxA/fxB sections.

Absent on the original NS7 per the manual: SHIFT, deck select / layer, slip mode, 33/45/78 speed selectors, EQ kill buttons (each EQ knob kills at full left), per-channel cue/PFL buttons, a platter direction switch (BLEEP/REVERSE is the nearest).
Headphone cueing is the HEADPHONE MIX fader plus a HEADPHONE MODE switch; the only motor on/off control is SCRATCH OFF.

Mixxx 2010 mapping conflicts: Deck A reloop_exit and Deck B cue_default both use 90 31; Deck B loop_out 90 50 breaks the +0x21 deck offset; the script's pitch ranges (8/10/30/100%) differ from the manual (8/16/50%).
Everything with "verified": false is a prior. Run Tools/ns7midi learn / ledscan / verify to confirm (see Tools/ns7midi/README.md).
